verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents webhooks for both products. The Marketing API sends HTTP POST updates on subscriptions, changed email addresses and campaign sending. Mailchimp Transactional POSTs message events such as send, bounce, open, click and unsub. Marketing webhooks require a Standard or Premium plan. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that the webhooks work reliably; webhooks are plan-gated for Free/Essentials users; detail on programmatic webhook registration, security and verification is thin in the evidence.
